title: Database Schema
content: Apply database schema aesthetic with data architecture feel. Entity-relationship diagram styling. Table representations with columns. Primary/foreign key indicators. Relationship lines (one-to-many, many-to-many). SQL query syntax highlighting. Data type badges. Index indicators. Schema navigation. Query result tables. Database design atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create database design aesthetic with ER diagrams, SQL styling, and data modeling visuals.
variants.detailed: Apply database schema aesthetic with data architecture feel. Entity-relationship diagram styling. Table representations with columns. Primary/foreign key indicators. Relationship lines (one-to-many, many-to-many). SQL query syntax highlighting. Data type badges. Index indicators. Schema navigation. Query result tables. Database design atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply database schema aesthetic with data modeling and DBA feel. ERD tables: rectangular boxes with table name header (bold, dark background), columns listed with names and types. Column display: name, data type (VARCHAR, INT, etc.), constraints inline. Key indicators: PK (yellow key icon), FK (blue key), unique constraint (fingerprint), nullable (question mark or empty). Relationships: lines connecting tables, crow's foot notation (one: single line, many: fork), relationship labels (has, belongs_to). Cardinality: 1:1, 1:N, M:N notation at line ends. Indexes: small lightning bolt or I indicator, composite index grouping. Data types: badges for type categories - numeric (blue), string (green), date (orange), boolean (purple), JSON (yellow). SQL syntax highlighting: keywords blue (SELECT, FROM, WHERE), table names white, strings green, numbers orange, functions purple, comments gray. Query formatting: proper indentation, one clause per line for complex queries. Result sets: table with column headers, row count, execution time. NULL handling: italic gray "NULL" display. Schema browser: tree view of database > schema > tables > columns. Explain plans: visual query execution plan, cost estimates. Constraints: check constraints, default values shown. Migrations: version history, up/down indicators. Stored procedures: procedure/function icons, parameter lists. Views: dashed table borders distinguishing from base tables. Triggers: event indicators (BEFORE/AFTER, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE). Implementation: SVG for ER diagrams, proper table components. Accessibility: diagram relationships described in text, tables have proper headers.
